name: Process profile: SAGA.pointcloud_tools.5
abstract: Process profile of the live OGC API - Processes process `SAGA.pointcloud_tools.5` (ZOO-Project, Geonovum testbed), with a process-type entry linking to its Implementation Profile. Static processDescription only, no execute/results/provenance.
description:
Process profile of the live OGC API - Processes process `SAGA.pointcloud_tools.5` (ZOO-Project, Geonovum testbed): <https://host1.tb.geonovum.geolabs.fr/ogc-api/processes/SAGA.pointcloud_tools.5>.

> Point Cloud to Shapes

(the process's own description, as served)

## The tool behind it

[SAGA pointcloud_tools 5 (Point Cloud to Shapes)](https://saga-gis.sourceforge.io/saga_tool_doc/7.3.0/pointcloud_tools_5.html) -- SAGA 7.3.0 tool library documentation, the version deployed on the testbed (not yet exposed by its processDescription).

Tool 5 of SAGA's Shapes - Point Clouds library (author O. Conrad, 2009; command line `saga_cmd pointcloud_tools 5`): converts a point cloud to a shapes layer of points. The documentation page gives the title only.

On this deployment:

- The live service labels its LAS input `application/x-ogc-lasf`, not the IANA-registered `application/vnd.las` the Implementation Profile declares.

## Implementation Profile

Implements [`Point cloud to shapes`](https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-generic-profiles/def/implementation-profile/point-cloud-to-shapes) (`generic-profiles.implementation-profile.point-cloud-to-shapes`, bblocks-generic-profiles).

Deployed inputs/outputs and the Implementation Profile's (`bindings` in `scripts/profiles.yaml`), with the data type each bound input/output inherits (`processDescription.inherited.json`):

| Deployed | Implementation Profile | Data type |
|---|---|---|
| `POINTS` | input `points` | `point-cloud` |
| `SHAPES` | output `result` | `feature-collection` |

## Examples

- `processDescription.json`: the processDescription as served, ZOO-Project-internal fields removed.
- `processDescription.inherited.json`: the same with what OGC 14-065r1 Table 21 has it inherit at the Implementation (instance level): keywords and metadata references to its profiles, and the data type of each bound input/output.
- `process-type.json`: its candidate process-type entry.

examples.title: Source (referenced)
examples.content: The processDescription is fetched from the live service, not copied: <https://host1.tb.geonovum.geolabs.fr/ogc-api/processes/SAGA.pointcloud_tools.5>.

examples.title: processDescription
examples.content: Live OGC API - Processes processDescription, normalised (ZOO-Project-internal fields dropped).

examples.title: processDescription with its inheritance (Implementation, instance level)
examples.content: The same processDescription as OGC 14-065r1 Table 21 wants it at the Implementation (instance level) of `https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-generic-profiles/def/implementation-profile/point-cloud-to-shapes`: the Implementation Profile's keywords (E) on the process and on each bound input/output, and, per footnote a, its list of metadata references to superior profiles extended with a Table 22 `implementation` reference to the Implementation Profile -- on the process only. Each bound input/output keeps its Implementation Profile counterpart's reference to the Generic Profile input/output (`generic-input`/`-output`) and adds one to that counterpart itself (`<Implementation Profile>/inputs/<name>`, `/outputs/<name>`, `implementation-input`/`-output`): roles defined by bblocks-generic-profiles, since Table 22 only names whole profiles. Each bound input/output also carries the `dataType` of that counterpart, a concept of bblocks-data-types. Which deployed input/output is which Implementation Profile one is `bindings` in scripts/profiles.yaml; inputs/outputs bound to none are the deployment's own additions (footnote b). Not what the deployment serves today (docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md Q-TABLE21-INSTANCE).

examples.title: process-type entry
examples.content: Registered ActivityType OWL class `https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-process-profiles/def/process-type/pointcloud/point-cloud-to-shapes` (`ospd.process-profiles.process-type`), proposed by GeoLabs and awaiting a register decision, linking to its Implementation Profile.
